value.rationale: An exponent-one rather than exponent-0.2378 reciprocal-log-log saving is an asymptotic-order refinement of an actively studied additive exceptional set. The local factor \(1/2\) and its summable errors produce a sharp density constant at the independent-block sieve level, clarifying a natural limitation of the motivating argument. It is not a trivial numerical threshold or arbitrary reparameterization.
